Class Employee

java.lang.Object
com.uni.models.User
com.uni.models.Employee
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Admin, Manager, ResearcherEmployee, Teacher
public abstract class Employee extends User
Abstract employee of the university. Adds salary/hire date and an inbox for inter-employee messages on top of User.

    • sendMessage

      public void sendMessage(User receiver, Message message)
      Send a message to another user. If the receiver is an Employee, the message lands in their inbox; otherwise the message is just delivered (and recorded on the message itself).

    • submitRequest

      public Request submitRequest(String subject, String body)
      Submits a request to the dean/rector. The request is stored in the DataStore with status PENDING; managers can review, sign and resolve it via Manager.viewRequests().
